prompt.text:
Implement a self-contained in-memory stock ledger. Export `StockChange`, `StockEntry`, and `StockLedger`. `StockChange` has `sku`, `quantity`, and `reason`; `StockEntry` additionally has an `id`. `StockLedger.record(change)` must trim `sku` and `reason`, require a nonempty SKU containing only ASCII letters, digits, `_`, or `-`, require a nonempty reason, and require a nonzero safe-integer quantity. Invalid input throws `TypeError` without changing the ledger. Successful entries receive deterministic IDs `E1`, `E2`, and so on. Export `entriesFor(sku)` in insertion order and `balanceFor(sku)` as the sum of quantities. Lookup SKUs are trimmed and validated by the same SKU rule. The constructor may accept initial changes, which are recorded in order. Every returned object must be a fresh snapshot: callers must never receive or mutate internal entry objects. The input objects and initial array must not be mutated. An empty ledger returns an empty array and balance zero. Provide one complete TypeScript source file.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
